concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-transfer-transactions-track-api]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace Transfers API transaction-query guide for scoped/paged balance-account rows, signed incoming/outgoing amounts, pending/booked and booking/value dates; sample IDs and internal amounts conflict.
warnings: Sample transaction IDs carry EUR suffixes beside USD amounts, and internal outgoing/incoming rows differ in amount and transfer ID (raw lines 231–352); do not reconcile them as a matched pair.
Bookable balance-account debit is not beneficiary-bank receipt; sample curl also departs from documented query format (raw lines 44–66, 379–416).
